nom: ZO Skin Health Complexion Renewal Pads

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one describing her T-zone as a disaster, report the pads help control and dry out excess oil there.
segments.mature: One 62-year-old reviewer reports brighter, more youthful-feeling skin with regular use, enough to go without makeup.

concerns.aging: One 62-year-old reviewer reports the pads brighten her skin and give it an overall more youthful feel, making her comfortable going without makeup.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the pads faded hyperpigmentation alongside clearing acne and improving texture.
concerns.blemishes: Multiple reviewers, including ones using it specifically for acne and clogged pores, report it clears breakouts, keeps skin acne-free, and reduces the appearance of pores with consistent use; no reviewer reported it worsening breakouts, though several note the effects depend on getting an authentic product.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin, including one whose T-zone she calls a disaster, report the pads noticeably mattify and dry out excess oil in that area.

extraits.texte: Ich habe das Produkt hier bestellt, da meine Ärztin nicht da war. Bin mir nicht sicher, ob das ein Originalprodukt ist. Es riecht anders, (viel mehr nach Alkohol)die Struktur auf dem Pad sieht anders aus und es fühlt sich auf der Haut anders an.(kein Peelingeffekt) Verpackung sieht identisch aus. Datum auf diesen Produkt 2027. Auf das, was ich von meiner Ärztin gekauft habe 2025. Deshalb weiß ich nicht, ob sich nicht vielleicht das Produkt verändert hat. Werde berichten, sobald ich mir eine neue Packung beim Arzt gekauft habe.

extraits.texte: I’ve been using the Renewal Pads for more than 2 years, and they dedinitely work! They’ve helped keep my skin clear, reduce acne and minimize pores. I love how easy they are to use and how refreshed my skin feels afterward. The only downside is the price. It’s a bit on the high side, so I cut each pad in half to make them laat longer, which works well for me. Even though they’re pricey, if you’re looking for a high -quality acne treatmemt that delivers resuls, these pada are definitely worth of investment.

This is a total game-changer! With consistent use, these Complexion Renewal Pads have significantly improved both the look and feel of my skin. They’ve been incredibly effective at clearing acne, preventing new breakouts, and fading hyperpigmentation. My skin feels much softer, and I’m impressed by the overall improvement in texture without any irritation. These are high-quality pads that offer excellent value for anyone seeking serious acne control. If you're looking for a glow-up, definitely make this a permanent part of your skincare routine.

I’m 62, and ZO Skin Health has truly been a game changer for my skin. The ZO Complexion Renewal Pads are an absolute MUST-have in my routine. They instantly brighten my skin and leave my face feeling incredibly clean and refreshed. After using them, my skin feels so renewed that I’m completely comfortable going without makeup—which says a lot! Whenever I run out, I notice a huge difference in my skin’s tone, brightness, and overall youthful feel. These pads have become a forever staple for me, and I wouldn’t want to be without them.

absolutely LOVE this product. you can clearly see results from it within the first few uses. this was recommended for me by my dermatologist & i’ve already restocked once since starting my new regimen. very important to moisturize afterwards. i’ve noticed it’s helped me keep up with cleanliness & having previously clogged pores; after exfoliating it delivers the best results. then moisturizing is key! great for oily skin.
Questi pads sono miracolosi. Utilizzati nella skin care abituale, aiutano a minimizzare i pori e ad "asciugare" letteralmente la zona T che per me era un disastro, avendo la pelle molto grassa
